title: Product Content Generator
description: A simple web application that allows users to upload a product image and describe their needs in a sentence. The app generates an e-commerce product title and three selling points tailored to the provided input.

features.name: Upload Product Image
features.description: Users can upload an image of their product to provide visual context for content generation.

features.name: Input Needs Description
features.description: Users can enter a sentence describing their specific needs for the product content, such as target audience or tone.

features.name: Generate Product Content
features.description: The application processes the uploaded image and user input to generate an e-commerce product title and three selling points.

constraints: The application must not require user authentication or account creation.
No editing or downloading functionality is required.
The application should be lightweight and optimized for quick processing.
target_users: E-commerce sellers or marketers looking for quick product content generation without account setup.
data_requirements: No persistent data storage is required; all processing should occur in real-time without saving user inputs or outputs.
